label: Rigid initial profile with full inclusion gives an E-necessary initial bearer
paraphrase: For every typed history profile with M as its frame, every E frame and selected world a: if the profile is rigid at a and every E-successor of a is an M-successor, then some bearer initial at a exists at every E-successor of a. Composes the #535 propagation with the #438 box-transfer law. Analyst formulation, attribution deferred.
